title: Kemegahan Nyang Karam
intro: Bayangkan nyoe: saboh jiwa nyang meuhias ngon peukayan nyang jroh dan dikeulileng le hareuta nyang hana hase tabayang. Ureueng nyoe geupateh keukayaan gobnyan geuteumee deungon kecerdasan gobnyan keudroe, hana tom geuakui sumber beukai nyang beutoi. Meujak lamkawan ureueng-ureueng nyang seutot sidroe nabi nyang peukasa, ureueng nyoe geutulak tieb-tieb panggilan keue miyueb até. Bak uroë njoë, geutanjoë tapeuhah identitas sidroë tokoh njang raseuki njang meugah njan djeuët keu teumpat istirahat akhé awaknjan.
clues: Lon udep bak masa sidroe nabi nyang geutawök saboh bansa nyang teuga that ubak keubeunaran.
Lon nakeuh bagian dari saboh komunitas nyang ka teupileh, bah pih meunan hate lon meuputa-puta nibak peusan nyan.
Meuh ngon pirak leubeh meutawan ulôn nibak peurintah ilahi peu mantong.
Kubah harta karu lon meutamah luah that sampoe saboh kelompok ureung agam nyang teuga hana jeuet ji angkat kunci.
Ulôn meubangga bahwa keukayaan lôn geubri keu lôn sabab iéleumé lôn keudroe.
Akhé jih, ulôn dan banmandum teumpat tinggai ulôn jiteugom lé bumoe sibagoe peuingat.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Sombong ateuh hareuta dan hana geutem seudeukah .
Meupeugot patong meuh nibak perhiasan nyang ka leleh .
Meunyatakan keutuhanan ateuh saboh keurajeuen nyang meukuasa .
Meu-aniaya ureueng meuiman awai di Makkah .
Meupimpin kampanye peuhanco Rumoh Suci .
trial.answer: Sombong ateuh hareuta dan hana geutem seudeukah .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Harta nyang kunci jih jibeban le ureueng teuga .
Saboh aneuk leumo meuh nyang jipeuhase su .
Saboh takhta nyang mulia nibak nanggroe nyang jiôh .
Saboh parit nyang peunoh ngon apui nyang meuble-ble .
Saboh teuntra gajah prang nyang gagah .
location.answer: Harta nyang kunci jih jibeban le ureueng teuga .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Diteulan le bumoe meusajan ngon teumpat tinggai .
Karam lam laot ngon teuntra .
Geutot udep-udep lam lueng apui .
Hanco le angen nyang meu-ulang-ulang .
Dipoh le saboh beureutoh nyang that teuga .
outcome.answer: Diteulan le bumoe meusajan ngon teumpat tinggai .

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
